caption: The drawing shows a large, brown vessel or jar with a rounded body, a narrow base, and a flared lip at the top. The surface of the jar features darker, vertical streaks running down from the top, resembling glaze drips. The jar has two small, rounded handles on either side near the upper portion of its body. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a separate, smaller detailed sketch set within a square, which shows a close-up, cross-sectional view of the jar’s rim, illustrating its curved profile. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of brown, with the vessel and its details darker than the light cream background. The name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
